description: The org's alert sources: tools such as Prometheus Alertmanager, Grafana and Datadog, or a script, that send their alerts here so they open incidents and page through the org's rotations. Per source: id, operator-set name, kind (alertmanager, grafana, datadog, generic), whether it is enabled (paused when not) or held by the plan, routes_to_nobody when its policy, the org default and its channels all reach no one, its escalation policy and channels, and when its last event arrived. The ingest URL and token are withheld: sources are set up in the Uptimepage app. Read-only.
name: list_alert_sources

AlertSourceItem.description:
One alert source in `list_alert_sources`. Its ingest URL and token are
withheld: they are a credential, set up in the app.

channel_ids.description: Channels bound to it, paged when no policy applies.

enabled.description: False while paused: a firing opens nothing, a resolve still closes.

escalation_policy_id.description: Its own escalation policy; `null` uses the org default.

grouping.description: `group` (one incident per alert group) or `alert` (one per alert).

held.description:
The plan holds it: a firing for a new alert is refused, alerts already
open still close.

last_event_at.description: RFC 3339 time its last event arrived; `null` when none has.

routes_to_nobody.description:
Its own policy, the org default and its channels all reach nobody. An
alert still opens an incident, and nobody is paged.

signed.description: Requests must carry a valid signature.

title: List alert sources
